user_statement: 在 __init__.py:161-194 的 safe_target() 里，路径被做了严格白名单和安全检查。它不能“越界”到仓库外，也不能用符号链接绕过安全边界。；在 __init__.py:218-286 的 apply_patch() 里，流程是：先取出目标文件当前内容：originals，再拿 proposal.base_hashes[path] 和当前文件digest(data) 比较，如果不一致，说明原文已经变化，拒绝应用。如果基础文档已经被人改过，那么这个补丁对应的旧位置可能已经失效；继续应用会覆盖新改动，风险很大，所以直接失败。另外它还在应用前后检查一遍，避免中途被改，应用时必须满足： 当前文件仍然是原始快照对应内容、应用期间没有被其他改动打断，否则就拒绝。；manifest 里记录的文件集合必须和 patch edits 一致，重算 diff 必须和 proposal.diff 完全一致
verified_checkpoints: Markdown-only paths, repository containment and symlink/reparse rejection
Current content hash must match base_hashes
Manifest paths equal edit paths; supplied and recomputed diff match proposal.diff

assistant_correction.text: Checks occur before application and immediately before each file write, not after writing. There is no lock covering check-to-replace and no post-write validation. Atomic replacement does not guarantee detection/prevention of every concurrent modification; rollback is attempted on caught errors.
